Fit progression GAMs for every gene

Source: R/progression_markers.R
fit_gene_gams.Rd

Applies build_gene_models() and summarize_gene_models() to each row of group_log_expr. A gene whose fit fails gets NA statistics and the error message in fit_status.

Usage

fit_gene_gams(
  group_log_expr,
  group_normalized_expr,
  model_data,
  min_normalized_expression = 0.1,
  gam_basis_k = 10L,
  use_sample_covariate = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

group_log_expr, group_normalized_expr

Gene-by-cell matrices of one group, columns aligned with the rows of model_data.

model_data

data.frame from prepare_group_inputs().

min_normalized_expression

A gene counts as expressed in a cell when its normalised expression is at least this value.

gam_basis_k

Upper bound of the smooth basis dimension.

use_sample_covariate

Add sample as a covariate when it has more than one level.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel back-end; serial by default.

verbose

Print a progress message. Default FALSE.

Value

A data.frame with one row per gene: the columns of summarize_gene_models(), fit_status, gene and expressed_fraction.
